referenceFunction.generalComment: The laser jet printer use (color, office) is calculated according to the share between active (2 hrs/day), standby (7 hrs/day) and off (15 hrs/day) modes taken from literature information. The dataset includes the share of the printer production (assumed life span 4 years, running 240 days a year), the energy consumption for the different modes in the use-phase, the rail and road transport from factory to user, the paper and toner usage as well as the benzene emissions during 1 hour of printing.; UUID: 0130a87a-840d-3f9f-9805-1fbfbc408c74
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Describes the use of a laser jet printer (color) in an office. Calculated per 1 hour of printing. Swiss supply mix applied for electricity consumption (low voltage).
